name: CoreWeave Dalton 1 & 2

timeline.event: Core Scientific investor presentation clearly shows Dalton 1 with a cleared pad on this month for construction. Source: https://investors.corescientific.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001140361-25-039864/0001140361-25-039864.pdf
Based on Satellite imagery, Dalton 1 is still under construction. The building appears mostly roofed except for the entrance area, and there are no cooling units or backup generators installed yet.

Building 1 is operational, given it was announced completed 4 months ago and looks completed in satellite imagery. All cooling/mechanical rows are installed, with no obvious active building construction visible.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: CoreWeave Dalton 1 & 2: current power 28 MW; owner CoreWeave.

explain: CoreWeave Dalton 1 & 2 is an operating AI data center in GA, GA, owned by coreweave. Epoch AI estimates it draws 28 MW today and 40 MW when finished.
